summary:
Where it lives and what it decides, as of the cited revision. The owning design is docs/coordination/2026-10-31-board-currency-gate.md (owning Outcome FS-GG/.github#4730, Delivery #5094); read it before changing any piece.

One rule implementation. scripts/board-currency-rules.py holds the versioned rule set (the RULESET constant) as a pure function of a snapshot; its clock is the snapshot's fetchedAt and finding IDs are rule:subject:reason with no ages. linkage_of() and override_of() are the single R1 implementation that the observer, the board-linkage check and the merge gate all import, so the three cannot disagree. Inputs are native state only (issue/PR state, PR bodies, native parent/sub-issue/blocked-by links, the Status, Work level and Track fields, and Root-login HTML-comment markers); an input that cannot be read is Unknown, never a pass. scripts/board-currency-fetch.py is the only reader and fails closed.

Three enforcement points (design section 2). (a) board-linkage (scripts/board-linkage.py, .github/workflows/board-linkage.yml) is its own light pull_request_target job, so it can later be a required context; it decides skip for non-routine PRs from the event payload before minting a token, and is advisory. (b) The merge gate in tools/routine-delivery.py (--board-gate) is the binding control because every Root merge goes through it; its default is advisory. (c) The hourly board-drift observer is the single writer of one findings issue (FS-GG/.github#4985) and merges currency findings through the drift observer's private-placeholder gate; R1 churn is body-only.

Writers. Done has exactly one writer, Project 3's built-in Item closed workflow; the merge gate never sets Done, refuses a Blocked preimage, and gives an overridden PR no Status transition. Accepting or closing an Outcome and creating remaining Deliveries stay Root decisions. The override is a recorded PR-body marker (exact grammar in the design, matched on one normalised text), evaluated before any board read, because enforce_admins leaves no bypass.

Enforce preconditions (Root, #5106 review). --board-gate enforce is refused, by main() and by summarize() itself, unless the running copy is in a checkout holding the shared rules module whose origin parses as exactly FS-GG/.github on github.com; the distributed receiver copy never enforces and its default stays advisory. The one Status write is an item-scoped guard Root accepted in place of the whole-project snapshot helpers. Before the send, a durable possible-send record keyed by repository and PR is written atomically to a private, user-owned directory; without it nothing is sent. After a crash, the next enforce run takes the already-merged path, finds the record and reads back only (never sends), rewriting the record to verified when the target is confirmed. A PR reference is never a Delivery in any of the three enforcement points.

Limits: this records source at the cited revision, not deployment, installed adoption or current board state. Phase 3 (running the .github copy with enforce, a required board-linkage context added to main protection with its app id, failing the observer on new IDs) needs separate Root approval. Re-read the design, the rule-set constant and live settings before acting.
title: Board-currency gate: deterministic Project 3 rules enforced at PR, merge and observer, with enforce preconditions
